//: SpecForge Orchestration Agent launch profile — the unrestricted authority
level for `session launch --role orchestrator`. Claude Code only: there is
deliberately no orchestrator.codex.toml / orchestrator.pi.toml sibling in
this version (Remote Control, the 'reachable from a phone' requirement, is
for `--role orchestrator`. Any other role (`lead`, `specialist:*`) that
selects this profile still gets the fixed command floor unioned in and the
per-session openspec/** read-only rules added, exactly as with any other
profile — the keys are ignored for it. Selecting the profile is the
deliberate act; keying the floor-lift to the role is what stops it becoming
a god-mode backdoor for lead / specialist.
`skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt: true` is required, not optional: in an
interactive tmux pane a bypassPermissions settings file alone does not
suppress prompts — Claude Code shows a blocking 'Bypass Permissions mode'
disclaimer, or downgrades the mode to `default`. This key is the persisted
form of having accepted that disclaimer. (TASK-ORC-001 hands-on finding.)
